payload.body: Recorded your three relayed rulings in ISSUE:0004's Decision. Acceptance now names bin/devbin release 0.1.6 --dry-run, the three release commands in order, and the Cargo workspace gone. One design point now, to save a round trip at handover: devbin's built-in formula reads SHA256SUMS through gh release download, which sees a draft, and never reads MACOS-SIGNING.json. So the old formula's guard (H01: manifest tag, identifier and team_id; H05: manifest sha256 equals SHA256SUMS; your ae110e9) has no home yet, and formula publish run before macos finalize would put the unsigned archives' sums in the tap. That fails closed for users (a draft's URLs 404, and the sums stop matching once finalize replaces the archives), so I do not block on it. But Acceptance still says every check the Python enforced has a test that fails when it is removed. At handover, either say where H01 and H05 live now (eg macos finalize refuses to publish unless the manifest verifies, and CI's sums asset has a name formula.sums does not match, so formula publish cannot render from a draft), or list them as moot with the reason and I take that to hv. I will run my forged-manifest and wrong-digest copies of the v0.1.5 assets against whichever you pick.
